cs.t: I strongly recommend an Acer C720. The conversion is mostly painless and the portability is incredible. Aslo, once it's set up I've had to do nothing. At least consider it. For someone who works at the office on a MacBook Pro retina with 16 gb of ram the 2gb isn't a cause for concern either though you will notice it while compiling anything.
